title: EvidenceReference
description: A reference to one record retrieved from the memory backend.

anchor.description: Snapshot/anchor identifier the proof is bound to, when the backend interface provides one.

backend_project.description: Schema 1.3: the project the backend itself reported for the record, which may differ from `project_id` (the run's project).

backend_ref.description: Backend-native record identifier (e.g. Hyphae memory id), when known.

backend_scope.description: Schema 1.3: the backend's scope for the record, when it reports one.

captured_at.description: Schema 1.3: when that snapshot was captured (RFC 3339).

content.description: Retrieved content. Treated everywhere as untrusted data, never as instructions.

proof_error.description: Set when proof generation for this record was attempted and failed upstream (e.g. a backend corruption signal). Integrity derivation treats corruption-class messages as `Invalid`, other failures as `Unavailable` — the reason is never silently dropped.

proof_file.description: Local proof artifact path for offline verification, when the backend writes proofs to disk (Hyphae memory profile does).

proof_ref.description: Schema 1.3: public identifier of the proof artifact covering the record, without any local path.

proof_request.description: Schema 1.3: the request the proof actually sealed. A proof covers its own request (e.g. the full record list of a project), which need not be the claim query that led the runtime to the record.

proof_sha256.description: Schema 1.3: SHA-256 of that proof artifact, lowercase hex.

retrieval.description: Schema 1.3: how the record was obtained.

snapshot_id.description: Schema 1.3: the sealed snapshot the record came from, when it did.

witness_file.description: Local witness artifact path paired with `proof_file`.

ProofRequest.description: The request a memory proof seals (schema 1.3): the operation and arguments the proof's own result answers.

project.description: Backend project string the operation ran against.

Retrieval.description: How an evidence record was obtained (schema 1.3).

oneOf.description: A recall against a running memory backend.
Served from a sealed, pre-captured snapshot.
A seeded test record; any proof outcome is scripted.
